subtitle: "Differential Geometry and Mathematical Art for Sustainability and Resilience"

This website documents a domain-neutral research platform connecting evidence synthesis, precise mathematical specification, executable models, verification, mathematical art, and scholarly writing.

## Current boundary

The platform-level application, system boundary, hazard, geography, and demonstrator remain `NOT_SELECTED`. The platform is intentionally designed before a preferred application is adopted so that repository structure cannot prejudge the evidence-led selection.

An application-specific **P–W–T thesis research package** is now maintained under [`docs/thesis/`](thesis/README.md). It records two candidate thesis trajectories, mathematical objects, candidate gaps, research questions, hypotheses, computational architecture, industrial translation, prior-art claim boundaries, and a long-term MSc-to-PhD research programme. Its claims remain evidence-bounded and do not alter the domain-neutral core unless a later decision record explicitly adopts them.

## Traceability principle

Every research object must have stable identifiers and explicit links:

$$
\text{source}\longleftrightarrow\text{claim}\longleftrightarrow
\text{mathematical object}\longleftrightarrow\text{implementation}
\longleftrightarrow\text{test}\longleftrightarrow\text{experiment}
\longleftrightarrow\text{figure}.
$$

These links provide provenance. They do not imply that a proposed transfer has been empirically validated.

## Foundation contents

- the `MSR-CA-001` provisional ten-chain research architecture;
- machine-readable model and experiment contracts;
- a small verified two-sphere geometry reference model;
- separate scientific and communication validation for mathematical art;
- automated integrity, testing, citation, documentation, and reproducibility checks;
- an evidence-bounded [thesis research consolidation](thesis/README.md) for sustainable and resilient infrastructure viability.

Start with the [repository architecture](architecture.qmd), [research-integrity standard](research-integrity.qmd), and [thesis research package](thesis/README.md).
